pointwise_gap_definition: sampled point gap(s) = ablation_abs_ey(s) - full_abs_ey(s); positive means the ablation has larger absolute lateral error at that sampled s
pointwise_worst_gap_definition: summary pointwise_worst_gap_vs_full = max_s(ablation_abs_ey(s) - full_abs_ey(s)); positive means the ablation is worse at its worst sampled point. Summary fields pointwise_gap_vs_full and pointwise_max_gap_vs_full are retained as backward-compatible aliases of this worst/max value.
pointwise_summary_alias_note: In summary CSV rows, pointwise_gap_vs_full and pointwise_max_gap_vs_full are retained for compatibility and equal pointwise_worst_gap_vs_full.
claim_boundary_note: This ablation is evidence for the contribution of the 24D observation / 31D lifted Koopman state inside this closed-loop controller and communication/fault setting. It must not be stated as Koopman being universally better than all linear models.
